slots.root: flex flex-col gap-1 transition-[width] duration-[var(--dur-state)] ease-state motion-reduce:transition-none
slots.item: flex items-center gap-row min-h-ctl-h px-nav-row-x py-nav-row-y rounded-control border-none cursor-pointer text-left no-underline font-body text-ctl shadow-control-rest active:scale-[var(--press-scale)] motion-reduce:active:scale-100
slots.badge: ms-auto inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-5 px-marker-x rounded-pill font-mono text-ctl-2xs font-bold tracking-badge
slots.trigger: flex items-center gap-row min-h-ctl-h px-nav-row-x py-nav-row-y rounded-control border-none cursor-pointer text-left font-body text-ctl ps-[calc(var(--pad-nav-row-x)*var(--dz-row-scale-x)+var(--pad-row-indent)*var(--arena-side-nav-depth,0))] bg-transparent text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) font-medium shadow-control-rest hover:bg-hover active:scale-[var(--press-scale)] motion-reduce:active:scale-100
slots.dot: absolute top-1 end-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-pill bg-primary

internal.current: the item's key is the nav's activeId
